name: Alofaaga Blowholes
reason: Wikivoyage See #1 (fee WS$5); a headline Savaii sight, a second visitor blog describes it. Rule 1-3.
objection: Touts demand money after coconut stunt; blowing only at high tide.

name: Peapea Cave
reason: Wikivoyage See: lava cave, swiftlets, 10 min from road; guide needed for locked entrance.
objection: For: named in See, real activity. Against: single source, locked, needs local guide, short visit.

name: Paia Dwarfs Cave
reason: Wikivoyage Savaii See #2 and Lonely Planet 'Dwarf's Cave' (lava tube, guide leads; bring torch). Two counted sources, a real guided activity.
objection: For: named See entry. Against: full-day guided effort, one source, access unreliable.

name: Mount Matavanu Lava Fields
reason: Wikivoyage Savaii See #4 and Lonely Planet 'Mt Matavanu Crater' both list it; 3 h walk to the 1905-11 lava field and crater. A distinct hike.
objection: For: named draw of the volcanic story. Against: single source, long walk, overlaps Saleaula lava field which is the accessible one.

name: Saleaula Lava Field
reason: Wikivoyage See plus visitor blog: accessible lava field with buried churches and Virgin's Grave (fee, guide).
objection: Fee/guide arrangement; could be seen as one overlapping lava feature with Matavanu.

name: Afu Aau Falls
reason: Wikivoyage See: 'most spectacular jungle waterfall on Savaii', half-hour walk; waterfall is a second-tier named stop.
objection: One source; needs 4WD track.

name: Pulemelei Mound
reason: Wikivoyage See: largest ancient structure in Polynesia; archaeological site visitors can walk to.
objection: Overgrown, little interpretation; one counted source.

name: Sapapaliʻi
reason: Wikivoyage only: a monument to John Williams's 1830 landing, a minor memorial with nothing else named (rule 3). Not found in LP.
objection: For: named See entry. Against: minor memorial/village, short stop.

name: Tafua Peninsula Rainforest Preserve
reason: Wikivoyage Savaii See #10 and Lonely Planet (superb rainforest, rugged lava coast with cliffs and sea arches) both name it; walk to the crater.
objection: For: a walk and reserve. Against: one source, little detail on access or facilities.

name: Falealupo Rainforest Preserve
reason: Wikivoyage See: village-run preserve with 25 m canopy walkway.
objection: One source; canopy walkway condition not confirmed.

name: Falealupo
reason: Village/peninsula wrapper; its draws (preserve, beach, church ruins) are separate candidates (rule 3, near-duplicate).
objection: Wikivoyage recommends renting a car for the peninsula; but that is covered by its spots.

name: Falealupo Church Ruins
reason: Only a travel blog names it; no counted source found in Wikivoyage Savaii (opened) or blog text.
objection: For: a known ruined-church landmark at the island's west end. Against: no counted source, ruin only seen from outside.

name: Satoalepai Turtle Reserve
reason: Wikivoyage Do: swim with rescued turtles, 35 min from ferry; blog confirms stop.
objection: Blog reports a disappointing, poorly run experience; one counted source.

name: Aganoa Beach
reason: Wikivoyage Do names it only as the surf operator's base; no sight or visit described, and no second source found.
objection: For: second-tier beach/surf. Against: mentioned only under Do/Sleep, expert surf, little to see.

name: Manase
reason: Wikivoyage lists Manase for north-coast surf, Raci's Beach Club, beach fales; village beach.
objection: For: island's main beach base. Against: a village; Wikivoyage gives no See entry.

name: Fagamalo
reason: Village named only as surf and dive base; no place to see in its own right (rule 2).
objection: Blog mentions a pleasant beach walk there.

name: Lesolo
reason: A surf break named in a list, no visitor place (rule 2).
objection: Surfers do travel for it.

name: Wreck of the Juno
reason: Wikivoyage Do: 1881 wreck, popular dive off Fagamalo/Manase.
objection: For: named dive site. Against: single operator, divers only, exact location unresolved.

name: Mataolealelo Spring
reason: Only a passing mention in a Sleep listing; no counted entry (rule 1).
objection: Fresh-water spring could be a swim stop.

name: Satuiatua
reason: Wikipedia and a blog call the beach picturesque with offshore surf; Wikivoyage only lists the resort.
objection: For: nice beach with snorkelling reef. Against: no counted See entry, resort beach.

name: Lano
reason: Village and surf break; no visitor source gives it a stop (rule 1).
objection: Beach fales exist there.

name: Moso's Footprint
reason: Wikipedia only; no visitor source (rule 1).
objection: Sits next to Falealupo, a plausible quick stop.

name: Silisili
reason: Wikipedia only; no visitor source or visit route (rule 1).
objection: Highest peak in Samoa.

name: Mata o le Afi
reason: Wikipedia only; volcano with no visitor stop (rule 1).
objection: Part of the volcanic story.

name: Mauga Afi
reason: Wikipedia only; cone with no visitor stop (rule 1).
objection: Part of the volcanic story.

name: Central Savaiʻi Rainforest
reason: Protected area with no visitor source or infrastructure; redirects to the island article (rules 1, 2).
objection: Large and ecologically important.

name: Vailoa
reason: Wikipedia only; archaeological village remains, no visitor source (rule 1).
objection: Related to Pulemelei.

name: Safune
reason: Village with no visitor listing (rule 1).
objection: Moana film history.

name: Salelologa
reason: Ferry town with market (Wikipedia/Wikivoyage Get in); a gateway at low rank, not an attraction.
objection: For: official gateway everyone passes through, market. Against: no See entry; Wikivoyage says it has no real towns.

name: Sāfe'e
reason: OSM sweep only; no visitor source (rule 1).
objection: Unverified, may be a fine beach.

name: Fai'a'ai Beach
reason: OSM sweep only; no visitor source (rule 1).
objection: Unverified, may be a fine beach.

name: Faleālupo Beach
reason: Wikivoyage (Sleep) says Falealupo Beach Fales are near 'one of the best beaches on the island'; OSM beach feature.
objection: For: guide-named best beach. Against: only a Sleep mention, one source.

name: Seeti Beach
reason: OSM sweep only; adjoins Faleālupo Beach (near-duplicate) (rules 1, 3).
objection: Possibly the same beach.

name: Sevemanaia Beach
reason: OSM sweep only; no visitor source (rule 1).
objection: Near Manase; could be the beach there.
